endpoint: First completed, accepted ONLINE verification within the total wall-time horizon. Posthoc-only successes are excluded.
denominator: Every registered target per family/arm; empirical verified-return fraction, not Kaplan-Meier or an IID population estimate.
censoring: No success event for failures; explicit censor timestamps and incomplete exposure retained. Draft counts are lower bounds, not imputed failures.
clock: Preparation/import, native work, feedback, and online verification share one wall clock. Actual accepted completion timestamps, no interpolation.
old_protocol: Earlier native-only-budget experiments are separate partial diagnostics and are never normalized or pooled into these equal-total-time curves.

registration.primary_endpoint: First exact verified returned geometry before the shared total-wall deadline. Online acceptance time, not native residual or post-hoc discovery.
registration.budget_scope: 120 total wall seconds including imports, initial flippability, native work, warm retries, SAT feedback and online exact checks;30/60/120 are milestones on ONE trajectory.
registration.posthoc_scope: Independent20-second bounded post-hoc diagnostics outside the primary clock; cannot credit an online success.
registration.selection: Same20 fixed canonical-distinct targets/family as the stopped native-budget diagnostic; reused data, not unseen targets. Nineteen-point source corpus mixes9fresh and11historical initial-SAT targets. No coordinate seeds.
registration.strategy_scope: Retry and feedback both use15-second native bursts and online checks; feedback adds the registered SAT treatment. Continuous variants check natural returns and the final stopped snapshot only.
registration.preparation_scope: Original uses the exact HEAD legacy check_flippable; all updated arms use the current FlippabilityChecker. Logical partial targets must agree, but actual preparation costs are charged separately inside each trajectory. Original-versus-updated is a package comparison, not a native-only ablation.
registration.baseline_scope: Common orientation adapter, logging, online exact acceptance and deadline wrapper across arms. This is not the literal whole original PointSAT driver; SAT generation is excluded.
registration.symmetry_scope: Identical cycles/fixed center for all19-point arms; unrestricted exact geometry is primary, exactC3/CNF are secondary.
registration.caps_scope: Same strict-x cap counting as prior exact checker; no extra repeated-x rejection or --ordered-x treatment.

registration.selection: Retain fresh commits first, then fixed historical source order and ascending line: initial SAT, satisfiable=true, original_solution only. Exclude the known positive-control canonical type, canonical duplicates, and primary Hamming distances below the registered minimum. No realization outcome filtering; no claim of uniform or all-fresh sampling.
registration.validation_cnf: Original CNF only. Historical two-proof-cut generation is a separately disclosed reused stratum. No diversity or proof-cut clause enters benchmark flippability, feedback, or acceptance.
registration.deadline: One validation child; parent wall watchdog terminates blocked native SAT calls. Committed rows survive interruption.

data.source: Read-only lscpu and /proc/meminfo in the execution environment
data.note: Virtualized environment: reported topology does not establish dedicated physical cores or constant clock speed. Corpus generation, preparation, native trials and audits share the two-worker limit; measured native CPU and wall time are retained separately. This snapshot does not measure per-process peak RSS.
